units.source_text: 他想此乃一片诚意，便换上了这旅装，并将平时常穿的那件衣服送给了明石姬。

en.t: He thought this was a gesture of sincere kindness, so he changed into the traveling clothes and gave the garment he usually wore to Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 这又使她增添了一种引起悲伤的纪念物。

en.t: This added yet another keepsake for her, one that would stir her sorrow.

units.source_text: 这衣服上浓香不散，安得不教人相思刻骨呢？

en.t: The deep fragrance still clung to the robe; how could it not make longing sink into the very bones?
